model_disagreement.name: When Parts Stop Agreeing
model_disagreement.description: A live Godot model study inside the Endless Museum. Turn native dials to change precision, part timestamps and deformation feedback; compare the original and corrected control. Display mesh scaled to fit the gallery; numerical values remain in source model metres.
interactions: Turn CONDITION and STEPS; STEP or PLAY / HOLD advances logical time.
CONTROL compares local coordinates, shared time or reading the original each pass.
model_disagreement.qfep_connection: A stable-looking body depends on compatible coordinates, timestamps and data dependencies. Changing one condition reveals a specific disagreement; it does not by itself establish a political meaning.
model_disagreement.status: Installed in Shader_05_Patterns, rear model gallery
